mechanics.name: The Curse of the Rim
mechanics.desc: A sickness rides every delver who has gone deep: now and then the world swims and the stomach turns, and the further down the floor, the worse it bites.
mechanics.flavor: Going down is a gift. Coming back is the price.

mechanics.name: The Curse of the Rim: Rotting Rim
mechanics.desc: A sickness rides every delver who has gone deep: now and then the world swims and the stomach turns, and the further down the floor, the worse it bites. The sickness is a creeping rot that eats health instead of the stomach.
mechanics.flavor: Going down is a gift. Coming back is the price.

mechanics.name: The Curse of the Rim: Footfall
mechanics.desc: A sickness rides every delver who has gone deep: now and then the world swims and the stomach turns, and the further down the floor, the worse it bites. Running in its area sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: Going down is a gift. Coming back is the price.

mechanics.name: The Curse of the Rim: Lantern-bearer
mechanics.desc: A sickness rides every delver who has gone deep: now and then the world swims and the stomach turns, and the further down the floor, the worse it bites. Carry a light through it long enough and it relents.
mechanics.flavor: Going down is a gift. Coming back is the price.

mechanics.name: The Curse of the Rim: Bleeding Rim
mechanics.desc: A sickness rides every delver who has gone deep: now and then the world swims and the stomach turns, and the further down the floor, the worse it bites. Each wave opens the old wounds and drains the legs of their strength.
mechanics.flavor: Going down is a gift. Coming back is the price.

mechanics.name: The Curse of the Rim: Backlash
mechanics.desc: A sickness rides every delver who has gone deep: now and then the world swims and the stomach turns, and the further down the floor, the worse it bites. It answers every real wound dealt in its area.
mechanics.flavor: Going down is a gift. Coming back is the price.

mechanics.name: The Curse of the Rim: Anchored
mechanics.desc: A sickness rides every delver who has gone deep: now and then the world swims and the stomach turns, and the further down the floor, the worse it bites. Hold a marked plate for a few seconds to still it.
mechanics.flavor: Going down is a gift. Coming back is the price.

mechanics.name: The Ebb and Flow of Magic
mechanics.desc: The floor's mana rises and falls like a tide: while it ebbs the delvers' magicules drain away, and the pulse repeats until the tide is turned.
mechanics.flavor: Mana is a living thing, and it breathes.

mechanics.name: The Ebb and Flow of Magic: Surging Tide
mechanics.desc: The floor's mana rises and falls like a tide: while it ebbs the delvers' magicules drain away, and the pulse repeats until the tide is turned. At the crest the tide throws the mana back with a shock that hurts.
mechanics.flavor: Mana is a living thing, and it breathes.

mechanics.name: The Ebb and Flow of Magic: Threshold
mechanics.desc: The floor's mana rises and falls like a tide: while it ebbs the delvers' magicules drain away, and the pulse repeats until the tide is turned. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
mechanics.flavor: Mana is a living thing, and it breathes.

mechanics.name: The Ebb and Flow of Magic: Switch
mechanics.desc: The floor's mana rises and falls like a tide: while it ebbs the delvers' magicules drain away, and the pulse repeats until the tide is turned. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.
mechanics.flavor: Mana is a living thing, and it breathes.

mechanics.name: The Ebb and Flow of Magic: Tide of Plenty
mechanics.desc: The floor's mana rises and falls like a tide: while it ebbs the delvers' magicules drain away, and the pulse repeats until the tide is turned. The tide gives as often as it takes: every wave also restores a share of the drained magicules, but bites hungrily afterwards.
mechanics.flavor: Mana is a living thing, and it breathes.

mechanics.name: The Ebb and Flow of Magic: Quorum
mechanics.desc: The floor's mana rises and falls like a tide: while it ebbs the delvers' magicules drain away, and the pulse repeats until the tide is turned. It only wakes when several delvers stand together in the area.
mechanics.flavor: Mana is a living thing, and it breathes.

mechanics.name: The Ebb and Flow of Magic: Keystone
mechanics.desc: The floor's mana rises and falls like a tide: while it ebbs the delvers' magicules drain away, and the pulse repeats until the tide is turned. One marked warden holds it up; slay the keystone to end it.
mechanics.flavor: Mana is a living thing, and it breathes.

mechanics.name: Gravity Change
mechanics.desc: The weight of the floor is not constant: at intervals the air lets go of everyone and they drift upward, to drop again when the spell tires.
mechanics.flavor: Down is only a habit.

mechanics.name: Gravity Change: Crushing Weight
mechanics.desc: The weight of the floor is not constant: at intervals the air lets go of everyone and they drift upward, to drop again when the spell tires. Gravity swings the other way and nails everyone to the stones.
mechanics.flavor: Down is only a habit.

mechanics.name: Gravity Change: Leap
mechanics.desc: The weight of the floor is not constant: at intervals the air lets go of everyone and they drift upward, to drop again when the spell tires. Jumping in its area sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: Down is only a habit.

mechanics.name: Gravity Change: Switch
mechanics.desc: The weight of the floor is not constant: at intervals the air lets go of everyone and they drift upward, to drop again when the spell tires. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.
mechanics.flavor: Down is only a habit.

mechanics.name: Gravity Change: Gravity Whirl
mechanics.desc: The weight of the floor is not constant: at intervals the air lets go of everyone and they drift upward, to drop again when the spell tires. The pull turns sideways and swirls, and nobody can walk straight.
mechanics.flavor: Down is only a habit.

mechanics.name: Gravity Change: Quorum
mechanics.desc: The weight of the floor is not constant: at intervals the air lets go of everyone and they drift upward, to drop again when the spell tires. It only wakes when several delvers stand together in the area.
mechanics.flavor: Down is only a habit.

mechanics.name: Gravity Change: Creeping
mechanics.desc: The weight of the floor is not constant: at intervals the air lets go of everyone and they drift upward, to drop again when the spell tires. Sneak through its area long enough and it loses interest.
mechanics.flavor: Down is only a habit.

mechanics.name: Field of Silence
mechanics.desc: A sphere of dead sound lies over the floor: whatever the delvers carry that hums with a spell stops answering for a few seconds at a time.
mechanics.flavor: No sound enters. No incantation leaves.

mechanics.name: Field of Silence: Mana Mute
mechanics.desc: A sphere of dead sound lies over the floor: whatever the delvers carry that hums with a spell stops answering for a few seconds at a time. It also bleeds a share of their magicules each time.
mechanics.flavor: No sound enters. No incantation leaves.

mechanics.name: Field of Silence: Greed
mechanics.desc: A sphere of dead sound lies over the floor: whatever the delvers carry that hums with a spell stops answering for a few seconds at a time. It reacts to the use of items in its area.
mechanics.flavor: No sound enters. No incantation leaves.

mechanics.name: Field of Silence: Switch
mechanics.desc: A sphere of dead sound lies over the floor: whatever the delvers carry that hums with a spell stops answering for a few seconds at a time. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.
mechanics.flavor: No sound enters. No incantation leaves.

mechanics.name: Field of Silence: Deafening Silence
mechanics.desc: A sphere of dead sound lies over the floor: whatever the delvers carry that hums with a spell stops answering for a few seconds at a time. It is worse than quiet: the sound is gone and so is the sense of direction.
mechanics.flavor: No sound enters. No incantation leaves.

mechanics.name: Field of Silence: Backlash
mechanics.desc: A sphere of dead sound lies over the floor: whatever the delvers carry that hums with a spell stops answering for a few seconds at a time. It answers every real wound dealt in its area.
mechanics.flavor: No sound enters. No incantation leaves.

mechanics.name: Field of Silence: Keystone
mechanics.desc: A sphere of dead sound lies over the floor: whatever the delvers carry that hums with a spell stops answering for a few seconds at a time. One marked warden holds it up; slay the keystone to end it.
mechanics.flavor: No sound enters. No incantation leaves.

mechanics.name: The Hours of the Hyperbolic Room
mechanics.desc: Time inside the floor runs thick: everybody wades through it, every motion costs more, and a day feels like a year.
mechanics.flavor: A year in there is a day out here. The body does not agree.

mechanics.name: The Hours of the Hyperbolic Room: Quickened Hours
mechanics.desc: Time inside the floor runs thick: everybody wades through it, every motion costs more, and a day feels like a year. Time runs the other way too: it throws everyone forward faster than they can steer.
mechanics.flavor: A year in there is a day out here. The body does not agree.

mechanics.name: The Hours of the Hyperbolic Room: Threshold
mechanics.desc: Time inside the floor runs thick: everybody wades through it, every motion costs more, and a day feels like a year. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
mechanics.flavor: A year in there is a day out here. The body does not agree.

mechanics.name: The Hours of the Hyperbolic Room: Anchored
mechanics.desc: Time inside the floor runs thick: everybody wades through it, every motion costs more, and a day feels like a year. Hold a marked plate for a few seconds to still it.
mechanics.flavor: A year in there is a day out here. The body does not agree.

mechanics.name: The Hours of the Hyperbolic Room: Stuttering Hours
mechanics.desc: Time inside the floor runs thick: everybody wades through it, every motion costs more, and a day feels like a year. Time hiccups: the walls blink and everyone is carried a step back to where they entered.
mechanics.flavor: A year in there is a day out here. The body does not agree.

mechanics.name: The Hours of the Hyperbolic Room: Footfall
mechanics.desc: Time inside the floor runs thick: everybody wades through it, every motion costs more, and a day feels like a year. Running in its area sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: A year in there is a day out here. The body does not agree.

mechanics.name: The Hours of the Hyperbolic Room: Endurance
mechanics.desc: Time inside the floor runs thick: everybody wades through it, every motion costs more, and a day feels like a year. Last out the time and it ends by itself.
mechanics.flavor: A year in there is a day out here. The body does not agree.

mechanics.name: The Labyrinth Is Alive
mechanics.desc: The dungeon rearranges itself: walls thicken out of nowhere and as quickly thin away again, closing off a path just as a delver commits to it.
mechanics.flavor: She is a mother, and she turns over in her sleep.

mechanics.name: The Labyrinth Is Alive: Closing Walls
mechanics.desc: The dungeon rearranges itself: walls thicken out of nowhere and as quickly thin away again, closing off a path just as a delver commits to it. The walls do not blink: they close round the party and stay shut a while.
mechanics.flavor: She is a mother, and she turns over in her sleep.

mechanics.name: The Labyrinth Is Alive: Bloodprice
mechanics.desc: The dungeon rearranges itself: walls thicken out of nowhere and as quickly thin away again, closing off a path just as a delver commits to it. It answers the dungeon's deaths: every few kills in the area set it off.
mechanics.flavor: She is a mother, and she turns over in her sleep.

mechanics.name: The Labyrinth Is Alive: Switch
mechanics.desc: The dungeon rearranges itself: walls thicken out of nowhere and as quickly thin away again, closing off a path just as a delver commits to it. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.
mechanics.flavor: She is a mother, and she turns over in her sleep.

mechanics.name: The Labyrinth Is Alive: Glass Walls
mechanics.desc: The dungeon rearranges itself: walls thicken out of nowhere and as quickly thin away again, closing off a path just as a delver commits to it. The walls turn to see-through glass that blinks the same way, so the way ahead can be read but not trusted.
mechanics.flavor: She is a mother, and she turns over in her sleep.

mechanics.name: The Labyrinth Is Alive: Stillness
mechanics.desc: The dungeon rearranges itself: walls thicken out of nowhere and as quickly thin away again, closing off a path just as a delver commits to it. Standing still in its area for a few seconds sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: She is a mother, and she turns over in her sleep.

mechanics.name: The Eclipse Dark
mechanics.desc: The lamps gutter and die in a wide ring round the delvers, and the dark that follows is thick enough to bite.
mechanics.flavor: Even the torches seemed to turn their faces away.

mechanics.name: The Eclipse Dark: Still Eclipse
mechanics.desc: The lamps gutter and die in a wide ring round the delvers, and the dark that follows is thick enough to bite. Nothing but the dark: no darkness potion, only the lamps gone.
mechanics.flavor: Even the torches seemed to turn their faces away.

mechanics.name: The Eclipse Dark: Nightfall
mechanics.desc: The lamps gutter and die in a wide ring round the delvers, and the dark that follows is thick enough to bite. It thrives where the light is low and strikes the delver who lingers in the dark.
mechanics.flavor: Even the torches seemed to turn their faces away.

mechanics.name: The Eclipse Dark: Lantern-bearer
mechanics.desc: The lamps gutter and die in a wide ring round the delvers, and the dark that follows is thick enough to bite. Carry a light through it long enough and it relents.
mechanics.flavor: Even the torches seemed to turn their faces away.

mechanics.name: The Eclipse Dark: Eyes in the Eclipse
mechanics.desc: The lamps gutter and die in a wide ring round the delvers, and the dark that follows is thick enough to bite. Things hunt in the dark: a swarm of small biters comes with the lamps going out.
mechanics.flavor: Even the torches seemed to turn their faces away.

mechanics.name: The Eclipse Dark: Wounded
mechanics.desc: The lamps gutter and die in a wide ring round the delvers, and the dark that follows is thick enough to bite. It smells a wounded delver and strikes when someone drops under half health.
mechanics.flavor: Even the torches seemed to turn their faces away.

mechanics.name: The Weeping Sky
mechanics.desc: A cold, endless rain falls on everyone who walks the floor, quiet and unhurried, and the water seems to remember every bad day.
mechanics.flavor: The rain does not hurry. It has centuries.

mechanics.name: The Weeping Sky: Weeping Thunder
mechanics.desc: A cold, endless rain falls on everyone who walks the floor, quiet and unhurried, and the water seems to remember every bad day. The rain turns to a storm, and bolts walk the floor.
mechanics.flavor: The rain does not hurry. It has centuries.

mechanics.name: The Weeping Sky: Clockwork
mechanics.desc: A cold, endless rain falls on everyone who walks the floor, quiet and unhurried, and the water seems to remember every bad day. It runs on a timer for as long as anyone stays.
mechanics.flavor: The rain does not hurry. It has centuries.

mechanics.name: The Weeping Sky: Lantern-bearer
mechanics.desc: A cold, endless rain falls on everyone who walks the floor, quiet and unhurried, and the water seems to remember every bad day. Carry a light through it long enough and it relents.
mechanics.flavor: The rain does not hurry. It has centuries.

mechanics.name: The Weeping Sky: The Cleared Sky
mechanics.desc: A cold, endless rain falls on everyone who walks the floor, quiet and unhurried, and the water seems to remember every bad day. The opposite: the sky clears and everyone is a little lighter, though the stillness itself weighs.
mechanics.flavor: The rain does not hurry. It has centuries.

mechanics.name: The Weeping Sky: Threshold
mechanics.desc: A cold, endless rain falls on everyone who walks the floor, quiet and unhurried, and the water seems to remember every bad day. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
mechanics.flavor: The rain does not hurry. It has centuries.

mechanics.name: Red Gate Magma
mechanics.desc: In the red dungeons the ground itself turns against the hunters: patches of floor go to glowing magma under their feet, for a while, on a timer.
mechanics.flavor: The floor lit up, and the hunters ran.

mechanics.name: Red Gate Magma: Ring of Fire
mechanics.desc: In the red dungeons the ground itself turns against the hunters: patches of floor go to glowing magma under their feet, for a while, on a timer. The magma forms a RING round each delver instead of a disc under them.
mechanics.flavor: The floor lit up, and the hunters ran.

mechanics.name: Red Gate Magma: Footfall
mechanics.desc: In the red dungeons the ground itself turns against the hunters: patches of floor go to glowing magma under their feet, for a while, on a timer. Running in its area sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: The floor lit up, and the hunters ran.

mechanics.name: Red Gate Magma: Anchored
mechanics.desc: In the red dungeons the ground itself turns against the hunters: patches of floor go to glowing magma under their feet, for a while, on a timer. Hold a marked plate for a few seconds to still it.
mechanics.flavor: The floor lit up, and the hunters ran.

mechanics.name: Red Gate Magma: Blue Gate Ice
mechanics.desc: In the red dungeons the ground itself turns against the hunters: patches of floor go to glowing magma under their feet, for a while, on a timer. Blue gates freeze the floor instead: sheets of blue ice, slippery and cold.
mechanics.flavor: The floor lit up, and the hunters ran.

mechanics.name: Red Gate Magma: Backlash
mechanics.desc: In the red dungeons the ground itself turns against the hunters: patches of floor go to glowing magma under their feet, for a while, on a timer. It answers every real wound dealt in its area.
mechanics.flavor: The floor lit up, and the hunters ran.

mechanics.name: The Current of the Rukh
mechanics.desc: The birds of fate flow through the corridors as a visible current: those who walk with it are mended, those who stand against it are chilled.
mechanics.flavor: Everything that lives is carried by the Rukh, and returns to it.

mechanics.name: The Current of the Rukh: Counter-Current
mechanics.desc: The birds of fate flow through the corridors as a visible current: those who walk with it are mended, those who stand against it are chilled. A counter-current: the Rukh run against the party, and every wave drains instead of heals.
mechanics.flavor: Everything that lives is carried by the Rukh, and returns to it.

mechanics.name: The Current of the Rukh: Threshold
mechanics.desc: The birds of fate flow through the corridors as a visible current: those who walk with it are mended, those who stand against it are chilled. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
mechanics.flavor: Everything that lives is carried by the Rukh, and returns to it.

mechanics.name: The Current of the Rukh: Switch
mechanics.desc: The birds of fate flow through the corridors as a visible current: those who walk with it are mended, those who stand against it are chilled. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.
mechanics.flavor: Everything that lives is carried by the Rukh, and returns to it.

mechanics.name: The Current of the Rukh: Falling Rukh
mechanics.desc: The birds of fate flow through the corridors as a visible current: those who walk with it are mended, those who stand against it are chilled. The Rukh fall like snow, and standing in them restores mana.
mechanics.flavor: Everything that lives is carried by the Rukh, and returns to it.

mechanics.name: The Current of the Rukh: Stillness
mechanics.desc: The birds of fate flow through the corridors as a visible current: those who walk with it are mended, those who stand against it are chilled. Standing still in its area for a few seconds sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: Everything that lives is carried by the Rukh, and returns to it.

mechanics.name: Wild Magic Surge
mechanics.desc: The raw magic of the floor goes off at random: each surge picks one wild effect, and nobody, the floor included, knows which.
mechanics.flavor: Roll the die. Tell the table what you meant to do.

mechanics.name: Wild Magic Surge: Benevolent Surge
mechanics.desc: The raw magic of the floor goes off at random: each surge picks one wild effect, and nobody, the floor included, knows which. A kinder table: the surge draws only the gifts, a heal and a shield of luck.
mechanics.flavor: Roll the die. Tell the table what you meant to do.

mechanics.name: Wild Magic Surge: Greed
mechanics.desc: The raw magic of the floor goes off at random: each surge picks one wild effect, and nobody, the floor included, knows which. It reacts to the use of items in its area.
mechanics.flavor: Roll the die. Tell the table what you meant to do.

mechanics.name: Wild Magic Surge: Switch
mechanics.desc: The raw magic of the floor goes off at random: each surge picks one wild effect, and nobody, the floor included, knows which. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.
mechanics.flavor: Roll the die. Tell the table what you meant to do.

mechanics.name: Wild Magic Surge: Cruel Surge
mechanics.desc: The raw magic of the floor goes off at random: each surge picks one wild effect, and nobody, the floor included, knows which. A crueller table: slowness, blindness and a blow of force.
mechanics.flavor: Roll the die. Tell the table what you meant to do.

mechanics.name: Wild Magic Surge: Quorum
mechanics.desc: The raw magic of the floor goes off at random: each surge picks one wild effect, and nobody, the floor included, knows which. It only wakes when several delvers stand together in the area.
mechanics.flavor: Roll the die. Tell the table what you meant to do.

mechanics.name: The Hunger of the Depths
mechanics.desc: Everything on this floor is a little bit hungry, and so are you: the stomach gnaws faster the deeper the floor, and only a proper meal puts it right.
mechanics.flavor: Eat the monster. It is only polite.

mechanics.name: The Hunger of the Depths: Cook's Hunger
mechanics.desc: Everything on this floor is a little bit hungry, and so are you: the stomach gnaws faster the deeper the floor, and only a proper meal puts it right. Hunger bites, but it also bargains: a smell of stew restores a share of health with each wave.
mechanics.flavor: Eat the monster. It is only polite.

mechanics.name: The Hunger of the Depths: Footfall
mechanics.desc: Everything on this floor is a little bit hungry, and so are you: the stomach gnaws faster the deeper the floor, and only a proper meal puts it right. Running in its area sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: Eat the monster. It is only polite.

mechanics.name: The Hunger of the Depths: Tribute
mechanics.desc: Everything on this floor is a little bit hungry, and so are you: the stomach gnaws faster the deeper the floor, and only a proper meal puts it right. Lay an offering on its altar to quiet it.
mechanics.flavor: Eat the monster. It is only polite.

mechanics.name: The Hunger of the Depths: Shaky Hands
mechanics.desc: Everything on this floor is a little bit hungry, and so are you: the stomach gnaws faster the deeper the floor, and only a proper meal puts it right. A starving hand shakes: every wave also breaks the grip on every item for a few seconds.
mechanics.flavor: Eat the monster. It is only polite.

mechanics.name: The Hunger of the Depths: Wounded
mechanics.desc: Everything on this floor is a little bit hungry, and so are you: the stomach gnaws faster the deeper the floor, and only a proper meal puts it right. It smells a wounded delver and strikes when someone drops under half health.
mechanics.flavor: Eat the monster. It is only polite.

mechanics.name: Pressure of the Heavy Aura
mechanics.desc: A hunter's aura, vast and unfriendly, lies over the whole floor: it presses on the shoulders and sets the knees shaking, more so with every pack the delver carries.
mechanics.flavor: Kneel. Or don't, and watch what happens.

mechanics.name: Pressure of the Heavy Aura: Crushing Aura
mechanics.desc: A hunter's aura, vast and unfriendly, lies over the whole floor: it presses on the shoulders and sets the knees shaking, more so with every pack the delver carries. The aura does not just press: it bruises. Standing still invites it.
mechanics.flavor: Kneel. Or don't, and watch what happens.

mechanics.name: Pressure of the Heavy Aura: Clockwork
mechanics.desc: A hunter's aura, vast and unfriendly, lies over the whole floor: it presses on the shoulders and sets the knees shaking, more so with every pack the delver carries. It runs on a timer for as long as anyone stays.
mechanics.flavor: Kneel. Or don't, and watch what happens.

mechanics.name: Pressure of the Heavy Aura: Creeping
mechanics.desc: A hunter's aura, vast and unfriendly, lies over the whole floor: it presses on the shoulders and sets the knees shaking, more so with every pack the delver carries. Sneak through its area long enough and it loses interest.
mechanics.flavor: Kneel. Or don't, and watch what happens.

mechanics.name: Pressure of the Heavy Aura: Pressure of the Light Aura
mechanics.desc: A hunter's aura, vast and unfriendly, lies over the whole floor: it presses on the shoulders and sets the knees shaking, more so with every pack the delver carries. A lighter aura: the pack weighs less, and it only presses when someone sprints.
mechanics.flavor: Kneel. Or don't, and watch what happens.

mechanics.name: Pressure of the Heavy Aura: Backlash
mechanics.desc: A hunter's aura, vast and unfriendly, lies over the whole floor: it presses on the shoulders and sets the knees shaking, more so with every pack the delver carries. It answers every real wound dealt in its area.
mechanics.flavor: Kneel. Or don't, and watch what happens.

mechanics.name: The Listening Walls
mechanics.desc: The dungeon hears everything: running boots and jumping feet wake whatever sleeps close by, and a quiet party is a safe one.
mechanics.flavor: Quiet. Even the goblins are listening.

mechanics.name: The Listening Walls: Goblin Ears
mechanics.desc: The dungeon hears everything: running boots and jumping feet wake whatever sleeps close by, and a quiet party is a safe one. What answers is a small band of goblin-like raiders, not insects.
mechanics.flavor: Quiet. Even the goblins are listening.

mechanics.name: The Listening Walls: Leap
mechanics.desc: The dungeon hears everything: running boots and jumping feet wake whatever sleeps close by, and a quiet party is a safe one. Jumping in its area sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: Quiet. Even the goblins are listening.

mechanics.name: The Listening Walls: Muffled
mechanics.desc: The dungeon hears everything: running boots and jumping feet wake whatever sleeps close by, and a quiet party is a safe one. Neither sprint nor jump for a while and it lets go.
mechanics.flavor: Quiet. Even the goblins are listening.

mechanics.name: The Listening Walls: Ears of Stone
mechanics.desc: The dungeon hears everything: running boots and jumping feet wake whatever sleeps close by, and a quiet party is a safe one. What answers is a shudder: the whole room shakes and the stones hurt.
mechanics.flavor: Quiet. Even the goblins are listening.

mechanics.name: The Listening Walls: Stillness
mechanics.desc: The dungeon hears everything: running boots and jumping feet wake whatever sleeps close by, and a quiet party is a safe one. Standing still in its area for a few seconds sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: Quiet. Even the goblins are listening.

mechanics.name: The Witch's Labyrinth Carpet
mechanics.desc: The floor changes its pattern into a loud ornamental carpet, and the room's whole sense of order goes with it: delvers lose their bearings and the walls seem to watch.
mechanics.flavor: Everything looks like a nursery, and nothing is safe.

mechanics.name: The Witch's Labyrinth Carpet: The Doll Carpet
mechanics.desc: The floor changes its pattern into a loud ornamental carpet, and the room's whole sense of order goes with it: delvers lose their bearings and the walls seem to watch. A second pattern, with a toy-box laugh: small shapes spawn out of the weave.
mechanics.flavor: Everything looks like a nursery, and nothing is safe.

mechanics.name: The Witch's Labyrinth Carpet: Threshold
mechanics.desc: The floor changes its pattern into a loud ornamental carpet, and the room's whole sense of order goes with it: delvers lose their bearings and the walls seem to watch. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
mechanics.flavor: Everything looks like a nursery, and nothing is safe.

mechanics.name: The Witch's Labyrinth Carpet: Keystone
mechanics.desc: The floor changes its pattern into a loud ornamental carpet, and the room's whole sense of order goes with it: delvers lose their bearings and the walls seem to watch. One marked warden holds it up; slay the keystone to end it.
mechanics.flavor: Everything looks like a nursery, and nothing is safe.

mechanics.name: The Witch's Labyrinth Carpet: Choir Carpet
mechanics.desc: The floor changes its pattern into a loud ornamental carpet, and the room's whole sense of order goes with it: delvers lose their bearings and the walls seem to watch. A pattern that hums: a note rings in each step and the party's items fall silent.
mechanics.flavor: Everything looks like a nursery, and nothing is safe.

mechanics.name: The Witch's Labyrinth Carpet: Leap
mechanics.desc: The floor changes its pattern into a loud ornamental carpet, and the room's whole sense of order goes with it: delvers lose their bearings and the walls seem to watch. Jumping in its area sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: Everything looks like a nursery, and nothing is safe.

mechanics.name: The Great Wind
mechanics.desc: A great wind blows through the halls like a living thing and pushes everyone one way, mild at first and then in gusts that make a fall dangerous.
mechanics.flavor: The Storm Dragon turns in her sleep.

mechanics.name: The Great Wind: The Eastern Gale
mechanics.desc: A great wind blows through the halls like a living thing and pushes everyone one way, mild at first and then in gusts that make a fall dangerous. The wind comes from the opposite side and drags everybody the other way.
mechanics.flavor: The Storm Dragon turns in her sleep.

mechanics.name: The Great Wind: Footfall
mechanics.desc: A great wind blows through the halls like a living thing and pushes everyone one way, mild at first and then in gusts that make a fall dangerous. Running in its area sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: The Storm Dragon turns in her sleep.

mechanics.name: The Great Wind: Switch
mechanics.desc: A great wind blows through the halls like a living thing and pushes everyone one way, mild at first and then in gusts that make a fall dangerous. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.
mechanics.flavor: The Storm Dragon turns in her sleep.

mechanics.name: The Great Wind: Gusting Gale
mechanics.desc: A great wind blows through the halls like a living thing and pushes everyone one way, mild at first and then in gusts that make a fall dangerous. It gusts and shoves, and each gust is a proper blow.
mechanics.flavor: The Storm Dragon turns in her sleep.

mechanics.name: The Great Wind: Threshold
mechanics.desc: A great wind blows through the halls like a living thing and pushes everyone one way, mild at first and then in gusts that make a fall dangerous. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
mechanics.flavor: The Storm Dragon turns in her sleep.

mechanics.name: The Anti-Magic Fog
mechanics.desc: A grey fog from the deepest tier smothers magic itself: spells and enchanted gear stutter, and the delver's own reserve of mana bleeds into it.
mechanics.flavor: A world with no magic left in it.

mechanics.name: The Anti-Magic Fog: Anti-Magic Devil's Breath
mechanics.desc: A grey fog from the deepest tier smothers magic itself: spells and enchanted gear stutter, and the delver's own reserve of mana bleeds into it. The fog is the devil's own breath; it hurts, too, in proportion to the mana taken.
mechanics.flavor: A world with no magic left in it.

mechanics.name: The Anti-Magic Fog: Clockwork
mechanics.desc: A grey fog from the deepest tier smothers magic itself: spells and enchanted gear stutter, and the delver's own reserve of mana bleeds into it. It runs on a timer for as long as anyone stays.
mechanics.flavor: A world with no magic left in it.

mechanics.name: The Anti-Magic Fog: Keystone
mechanics.desc: A grey fog from the deepest tier smothers magic itself: spells and enchanted gear stutter, and the delver's own reserve of mana bleeds into it. One marked warden holds it up; slay the keystone to end it.
mechanics.flavor: A world with no magic left in it.

mechanics.name: The Anti-Magic Fog: Thin Fog
mechanics.desc: A grey fog from the deepest tier smothers magic itself: spells and enchanted gear stutter, and the delver's own reserve of mana bleeds into it. A thin fog that taxes mana a little less but lingers for longer.
mechanics.flavor: A world with no magic left in it.

mechanics.name: The Anti-Magic Fog: Greed
mechanics.desc: A grey fog from the deepest tier smothers magic itself: spells and enchanted gear stutter, and the delver's own reserve of mana bleeds into it. It reacts to the use of items in its area.
mechanics.flavor: A world with no magic left in it.

mechanics.name: The Witch's Miasma
mechanics.desc: The scent of a witch lies on the floor like fog: nobody dies of it, but no wound heals, and the longer it lingers the more the party starts hearing its own names.
mechanics.flavor: It smells like jealousy.

mechanics.name: The Witch's Miasma: Scent of Envy
mechanics.desc: The scent of a witch lies on the floor like fog: nobody dies of it, but no wound heals, and the longer it lingers the more the party starts hearing its own names. The scent of envy turns allies against one another: wounds sting extra when the party stands apart.
mechanics.flavor: It smells like jealousy.

mechanics.name: The Witch's Miasma: Clockwork
mechanics.desc: The scent of a witch lies on the floor like fog: nobody dies of it, but no wound heals, and the longer it lingers the more the party starts hearing its own names. It runs on a timer for as long as anyone stays.
mechanics.flavor: It smells like jealousy.

mechanics.name: The Witch's Miasma: Keystone
mechanics.desc: The scent of a witch lies on the floor like fog: nobody dies of it, but no wound heals, and the longer it lingers the more the party starts hearing its own names. One marked warden holds it up; slay the keystone to end it.
mechanics.flavor: It smells like jealousy.

mechanics.name: The Witch's Miasma: Scent of Sloth
mechanics.desc: The scent of a witch lies on the floor like fog: nobody dies of it, but no wound heals, and the longer it lingers the more the party starts hearing its own names. The scent of sloth: everything is a bit slower.
mechanics.flavor: It smells like jealousy.

mechanics.name: The Witch's Miasma: Backlash
mechanics.desc: The scent of a witch lies on the floor like fog: nobody dies of it, but no wound heals, and the longer it lingers the more the party starts hearing its own names. It answers every real wound dealt in its area.
mechanics.flavor: It smells like jealousy.

mechanics.name: Shinsu Density
mechanics.desc: Shinsu lies thick or thin from room to room: in the thick places the body is slower and tires fast, in the thin ones a leap carries far.
mechanics.flavor: Each floor has a Test, and the air is part of it.

mechanics.name: Shinsu Density: Thin Shinsu
mechanics.desc: Shinsu lies thick or thin from room to room: in the thick places the body is slower and tires fast, in the thin ones a leap carries far. A thin pocket: speed rather than slowness, a long leap rather than a heavy foot.
mechanics.flavor: Each floor has a Test, and the air is part of it.

mechanics.name: Shinsu Density: Clockwork
mechanics.desc: Shinsu lies thick or thin from room to room: in the thick places the body is slower and tires fast, in the thin ones a leap carries far. It runs on a timer for as long as anyone stays.
mechanics.flavor: Each floor has a Test, and the air is part of it.

mechanics.name: Shinsu Density: Anchored
mechanics.desc: Shinsu lies thick or thin from room to room: in the thick places the body is slower and tires fast, in the thin ones a leap carries far. Hold a marked plate for a few seconds to still it.
mechanics.flavor: Each floor has a Test, and the air is part of it.

mechanics.name: Shinsu Density: Shinsu Flux
mechanics.desc: Shinsu lies thick or thin from room to room: in the thick places the body is slower and tires fast, in the thin ones a leap carries far. The density flickers from thick to thin and back, throwing the party about.
mechanics.flavor: Each floor has a Test, and the air is part of it.

mechanics.name: Shinsu Density: Footfall
mechanics.desc: Shinsu lies thick or thin from room to room: in the thick places the body is slower and tires fast, in the thin ones a leap carries far. Running in its area sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: Each floor has a Test, and the air is part of it.

mechanics.name: Cocytus
mechanics.desc: The deepest of the cold halls lays an unbroken frost over the floor: breath hangs in the air, bones ache, and slow ones are covered in rime.
mechanics.flavor: The cold of the ninth circle does not forgive.

mechanics.name: Cocytus: Cocytus Blizzard
mechanics.desc: The deepest of the cold halls lays an unbroken frost over the floor: breath hangs in the air, bones ache, and slow ones are covered in rime. A blizzard rather than a still cold: a wind drives the party and the snow bites.
mechanics.flavor: The cold of the ninth circle does not forgive.

mechanics.name: Cocytus: Stillness
mechanics.desc: The deepest of the cold halls lays an unbroken frost over the floor: breath hangs in the air, bones ache, and slow ones are covered in rime. Standing still in its area for a few seconds sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: The cold of the ninth circle does not forgive.

mechanics.name: Cocytus: Lantern-bearer
mechanics.desc: The deepest of the cold halls lays an unbroken frost over the floor: breath hangs in the air, bones ache, and slow ones are covered in rime. Carry a light through it long enough and it relents.
mechanics.flavor: The cold of the ninth circle does not forgive.

mechanics.name: Cocytus: Frost Giant's Breath
mechanics.desc: The deepest of the cold halls lays an unbroken frost over the floor: breath hangs in the air, bones ache, and slow ones are covered in rime. A giant's breath, a single enormous burst that damages and shoves.
mechanics.flavor: The cold of the ninth circle does not forgive.

mechanics.name: Cocytus: Backlash
mechanics.desc: The deepest of the cold halls lays an unbroken frost over the floor: breath hangs in the air, bones ache, and slow ones are covered in rime. It answers every real wound dealt in its area.
mechanics.flavor: The cold of the ninth circle does not forgive.
